headline: Expedia confirmed attackers got in through a compromised third-party data platform provider; a group claims a billion records.
summary: First build from Skift (Tier 2; partly behind a subscription) and Cybernews and The Seattle Times (all Tier 2, read Nov 22). c001 vendor attack Confirmed on Expedia's own statement to Skift and to The Seattle Times; no company page was found. c003, c005, c008, c009 Reported; c004 the billion-record claim Unverified; c006 whether customer data was taken and c007 vendor and method Not established. A larger figure of over 1TB in the sweep notes was not in either source and was dropped. The group's leak page was not visited. Privacy check done: no staff, researchers, reporters or contacts named.
author: Research agent
